experience_source.quote: Every contractor shall register with the department.

interval_years.quote: A certificate of registration shall be valid for two years and shall be renewed on or before the expiration date.

exists.quote: "Department" means the department of labor and industries.

regulatory_model.quote: Every contractor shall register with the department.

credential_type.quote: A certificate of registration shall be valid for two years and shall be renewed on or before the expiration date. The department shall issue to the applicant a certificate of registration upon compliance with the registration requirements of this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: It is a gross misdemeanor for any contractor to: (a) Advertise, offer to do work, submit a bid, or perform any work as a contractor without being registered as required by this chapter

title_protection.quote: All advertising and all contracts, correspondence, cards, signs, posters, papers, and documents which show a contractor's name or address shall show the contractor's name or address as registered under this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: It is a gross misdemeanor for any contractor to: (a) Advertise, offer to do work, submit a bid, or perform any work as a contractor without being registered as required by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising, bidding, or performing work as a contractor without being registered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertise, offer to do work, submit a bid, or perform any work as a contractor without being registered as required by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising, bidding, or performing work while registration is suspended or revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertise, offer to do work, submit a bid, or perform any work as a contractor when the contractor's registration is suspended or revoked

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a false or expired registration number in purchasing or offering to purchase an advertisement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use a false or expired registration number in purchasing or offering to purchase an advertisement for which a contractor registration number is required

disciplinary_grounds.description: Transferring a valid registration to or allowing an unregistered contractor to work under another's registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Transfer a valid registration to an unregistered contractor or allow an unregistered contractor to work under a registration issued to another contractor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subcontracting to or using an unregistered contractor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Subcontract to or use an unregistered contractor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an unsatisfied final judgment against the registrant for work within scope of chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the department shall suspend an active registration if (i) the department has determined that the registrant has an unsatisfied final judgment against it for work within the scope of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying information on the registration application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the department has determined that the registrant falsified information on the application, unless the error was inadvertent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain a valid unified business identifier number
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the registrant does not maintain a valid unified business identifier number

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to have an active and valid certificate of registration with the Department of Revenue
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the registrant does not have an active and valid certificate of registration with the department of revenue

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation or revocation of surety bond or insurance policy resulting in automatic suspension
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a contractor's surety bond or other security has an unsatisfied judgment against it or is canceled, or if the contractor's insurance policy is canceled, the contractor's registration shall be automatically suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certified by DSHS as not in compliance with a support order or visitation order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The department shall immediately suspend the certificate of registration of a contractor who has been certified by the department of social and health services as a person who is not in compliance with a support order or a visitation order

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising as a contractor when not registered, or failing to show registration number in ads
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any advertising by a person, firm, or corporation soliciting work as a contractor when that person, firm, or corporation is not registered pursuant to this chapter is a violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of a misdemeanor or infraction under this chapter constitutes a Consumer Protection Act violation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The fact that a contractor is found to have committed a misdemeanor or infraction under this chapter shall be deemed to affect the public interest and shall constitute a violation of chapter 19.86 RCW.

bonding_required.quote: Each applicant shall file with the department a surety bond issued by a surety insurer who meets the requirements of chapter 48.28 RCW in the sum of $30,000 if the applicant is a general contractor or $15,000 if the applicant is a specialty contractor.

insurance_required.quote: At the time of registration and subsequent reregistration, the applicant shall furnish insurance or financial responsibility in the form of an assigned account in the amount of fifty thousand dollars for injury or damages to property, and one hundred thousand dollars for injury or damage including death to any one person, and two hundred thousand dollars for injury or damage including death to more than one person.

definition_quote.value: "Contractor" includes any person, firm, corporation, or other entity who or which, in the pursuit of an independent business undertakes to, or offers to undertake, or submits a bid to, construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, develop, move, wreck, or demolish any building, highway, road, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development, or improvement attached to real estate or to do any part thereof including the installation of carpeting or other floor covering, the erection of scaffolding or other structures or works in connection therewith, the installation or repair of roofing or siding, performing tree removal services, or cabinet or similar installation
definition_quote.quote: "Contractor" includes any person, firm, corporation, or other entity who or which, in the pursuit of an independent business undertakes to, or offers to undertake, or submits a bid to, construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, develop, move, wreck, or demolish any building, highway, road, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development, or improvement attached to real estate or to do any part thereof including the installation of carpeting or other floor covering, the erection of scaffolding or other structures or works in connection therewith, the installation or repair of roofing or siding, performing tree removal services, or cabinet or similar installation

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: All advertising that shows the contractor's name or address shall show the contractor's current registration number.

insurance_personal_injury_minimum_usd.quote: one hundred thousand dollars for injury or damage including death to any one person

insurance_property_damage_minimum_usd.quote: fifty thousand dollars for injury or damages to property

self_insurance_permitted.quote: In lieu of the surety bond required by this section the contractor may file with the department an assigned savings account, upon forms provided by the department.

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: Any work or operation on one undertaking or project by one or more contracts, the aggregate contract price of which for labor and materials and all other items is less than five hundred dollars, such work or operations being considered as of a casual, minor, or inconsequential nature.

local_trade_licensing_preserved.quote: A licensed architect or civil or professional engineer acting solely in his or her professional capacity, an electrician certified under the laws of the state of Washington, or a plumber certified under the laws of the state of Washington or licensed by a political subdivision of the state of Washington while operating within the boundaries of such political subdivision.

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: A certificate of registration shall be valid for two years and shall be renewed on or before the expiration date.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: No contractor subject to this section may bring or maintain any lien claim under chapter 60.04 RCW based on any contract to which this section applies without alleging and proving that the contractor has provided the customer with a copy of the disclosure statement as required in subsection (1) of this section.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: No person engaged in the business or acting in the capacity of a contractor may bring or maintain any action in any court of this state for the collection of compensation for the performance of any work or for breach of any contract for which registration is required under this chapter without alleging and proving that he or she was a duly registered contractor and held a current and valid certificate of registration at the time he or she contracted for the performance of such work

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
